test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The logic followed here is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2225a2eaadc15e5a570856b58a9c4b211823ca0ff70a811ff879739530a4842b.png] 

Option 1) FCG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7bab3080796137a68362f5c5106a831fd3c7c7618541b584fa45bf1231ded3b.png] 

Option 2) IFK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b769aa103ac8d9d5467e9ddd69e7f2c437ca06abee6624f7be06d6c04184a7b.png] 

Option 3) QNS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3db3c02c844797e761e1e2b4bbe35a8ba1fee979c2cf72192f231b00610b1ae1.png] 

Option 4) LIN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60af618e4d5284e8034e168203c4db6d618462ed47db4b45e921bcf21c8ae339.png] 

So, 'FCG' letter-cluster does not belong to that group.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
